# Indiquant

> Open-source AI quant research OS for Indian equity markets (NSE and BSE). Hypothesis-first discovery, walk-forward backtesting, and Google Trends search-demand scores. A Money Radar product by Thugir Group, maintained by Ryan Editraj.

Indiquant is a research lab. It records hypotheses, backtests them, and walk-forward validates them. It does not place live broker orders.

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/ryaneditraj/indiquant
- Product page: https://moneyradar.in/indiquant
- Parent brand: https://moneyradar.in
- Author: https://github.com/ryaneditraj
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/ryaneditraj
- License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (commercial use needs a separate license from Money Radar)

## What it does

- Hypothesis-first AI research loop with experiment IDs
- Walk-forward, Monte Carlo, out-of-sample, and lookahead checks
- Google Trends Search Demand Score (relative 0–100 index, not absolute volume)
- Parquet OHLCV store and DuckDB SELECT analytics over registered views
- Offline fixture demo with no broker keys

## Questions

### What is Indiquant?
An open-source quant research OS for NSE and BSE. Hypothesis, backtest, walk-forward validation, experiment ID.

### Is Indiquant a trading bot?
No. It does not place live orders. A paper broker plugin simulates fills.

### Can I backtest without a broker API key?
Yes. The default provider is an offline fixture. Sample CSVs ship in data/sample_csv.

### What does the search-demand score measure?
A relative 0–100 Google Trends index for configured queries in India. Not absolute volume. Not a return forecast.

### Can I use Indiquant commercially?
Only with a separate license from Money Radar / Thugir Group. The public license is PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.

### Who maintains it?
Ryan Editraj (https://github.com/ryaneditraj). Product of Money Radar by Thugir Group.

### How do I report a vulnerability?
Private GitHub security advisory on ryaneditraj/indiquant. See SECURITY.md. Do not open a public issue.
